rows.note: This is the usual colloquial choice for doing or saying something in private; it is the all-purpose one.

example.english: We privately agreed it first and only announced it on stage.
example.traditional: 我哋私底下傾好咗先，出場先宣布。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 si1 dai2 haa6 king1 hou2 zo2 sin1 ceot1 coeng4 sin1 syun1 bou3

rows.note: Use this concise alternative when contrasting private dealings with public or official ones.

example.english: We settled this privately; it has not been officially announced.
example.traditional: 呢件事我哋私下傾掂咗，未有正式公布。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 si1 haa6 king1 dim1 zo2 mei6 jau5 zing3 sik1 gung1 bou3
